item.title: Strong earthquake shakes Tamarinda coast, buildings damaged
item.description: Strong earthquake shakes Tamarinda coast, buildings damaged. The quake struck about 40 kilometres offshore at a shallow depth, the geological survey said. At least 12 people were killed and dozens injured, local officials said.

item.title: Norvania central bank holds interest rates steady
item.description: Norvania central bank holds interest rates steady. The bank signalled that any future cuts would depend on incoming data.

item.title: Thousands evacuated as wildfires spread across Mirabel province
item.description: Thousands evacuated as wildfires spread across Mirabel province. Strong winds pushed flames toward several towns on Friday. Emergency services said more than 3,000 residents had been told to leave their homes.
